Verbatim rulings (DECISION_CHAIN.md): 'no reinventing or customizing', 'Assemble production grade components > build from scratch', 'if i cannot see it - its not real', 'Take the simplest path, don't overthink or over engineer', 'indicators are not interactable, they just render', vision-in-the-loop verification = the agent LOOKS at frames against a written expectation.

Root failure pattern in this repo (FAILURE_LOG F-08..F-17, THEATRICALITY_LOG): a verification SUBSTITUTE (gate line, parity table, 4B VLM judge, recording nobody watched) stood in for verification. Countermeasure: write expectation BEFORE the render; LOOK at the image yourself; name deltas; parity != correctness; probe the target object not the input; assert served file == source file.

F-17: 'is it accurate / are zones correct' had NO mechanism. Required: per-drawing semantic read: name a drawing on a named bar -> state its CLAIM -> look at the chart -> verdict + specific delta -> repeat across engines/TFs.

Temporal boundary: only bars <= analysis point exist (Monday London open ~02:00 ET = 06:00Z in EDT). Forecast for the rest of that week must use nothing later. Bar Replay at any past date must reproduce the same rendering.

LIQUIDITY. LSZ (green sweep zones) = standard Earth; IP zones = HEAVY Earth. Foundation everything anchors to. SL must be shielded by liquidity; thin zones never entry/SL; rocket SL always 1 full pip outside back edge; thin zones inside a 4H pool count double. Infrastructure: stop-limit mechanics, capital protection, time anchors.

SUPPLY & DEMAND (institutional firepower). BoM = hottest Fire (origin), MoM = cooling continuation Fire. Needs Earth as fuel (intrinsically linked). Fire cannot be sustained: after 2 strong piercing swings expect 1-2 days HTF consolidation. Ignition events: BS, WL, Recovery Surge.

MACRO SHAPES (BS, WL, R, SS, ...). The wave forms energy materialises into; shape chain = wave prediction; gives structure to Fire. Consolidation = calm pool, SS = ripples, BS = tidal wave. Engine2 is primarily Water.

FIBONACCI. No intrinsic density; becomes a SPIDERWEB only when anchored to Earth points (candlewick, swing H/L, zone edges): 'Poorly anchored spiderwebs get blown away and don't exist'. Air PIERCES FIRE (4H BoM S/D), not Earth; dual nature with Fire: fans it (accelerate) or blows it out (reverse). Self-referential wormholes 0.382->1.382, 0.618->1.618.

Elemental cycle Earth -> Fire -> Water -> Air -> Earth: liquidity forms; S/D ignites at Earth anchor; energy takes a wave shape; Fib maps the trajectory; Fib-confirmed levels become new liquidity. Same energy at four states.

TWO AXES: density = what a mechanic IS (Earth/Fire/Water/Air); attack = how a trade ENGAGES (FR = Air tool in Fire-style attack; LR = Earth tool in Water-style attack; FLR = Air+Earth in Earth-heavy attack). Do not conflate.
4H->4H: each timeframe's liquidity is its own element/density. 4H pierces 1H/30m but stops at another 4H; 1H and 4H interchangeable (4H dominant); never more than 2 TF dimensions up.

Conservation of energy: after 2 strong piercing swing moves expect 1-2 full days of HTF consolidation. WL -> RWL -> Swing Scalps -> BS/WLS/PBS is the recovery cycle. 'Today's move often ends up being tomorrow's.' Assume price moves at 30-50% of the speed you think (Trading Speed Rule, +1 day).

MoM zones are LADDER STEPS ONLY: never reversal entries on MoM, EVER; valid as trend-aligned ladder fuel and as TP for the opposing direction. BoM zones = entry candidates (100% reaction if unmitigated).
Price ALWAYS sweeps liquidity zone by zone in sequential order, never skipping; Law-14 refined: no teleport past UNMITIGATED zones, may pass mitigated ones during BS momentum.

Zone pressure lifecycle: VIRGIN -> ACTIVE-1 (~80% react) -> ACTIVE-2 (~50%) -> DEPLETED (3+; TP only, 'zones usually fail on the THIRD mitigation') -> FORTRESS (4+ strong, Fire->Earth phase change) -> BROKEN. 4H MoM is one-and-done (minor reaction then pierce).

ENGINE 1 = WHERE ARE THE WALLS. Maps Earth (IP + LSZ) and Fire (BoM/MoM S/D). 9-pillar 6-dimension confluence (0-14) -> pressure degree (EXTREME 12-14 <10% ZFP ... MINIMAL <60%+), ZFP, POI tiers, BoM/MoM, reaction counter, intra-zone key levels (Step 0.6), LSZ scan (Step 0.45), 4H singular-candle zones (Step 0f). Confirmed ~95%. FROZEN.

ENGINE 2 = WHAT PATH WILL ENERGY TAKE. Macro shape chain (1H primary, 4H validation) + ZFP-conditioned transitions + consolidation phase + day-by-day decomposition (Mon-Fri) + alternative chain. Max chain length 5; stop if cumulative confidence <25%. Confirmed ~95%. FROZEN.

ENGINE 3 = WHERE DO I SURF. Corrected spec = 12-phase pipeline (E2 designates, E3 obeys; R3 law): universe -> day bridge -> zone selection -> entry -> SL/TP/RRR -> confidence -> multi-setup -> day/session labels -> blind-execution labels -> reinforcement -> cascade mirror -> avatar state -> 3D audit. UNTESTED live; will be validated by the finished indicator.

9 pillars: P1 multi-TF pivots (classic/fib/camarilla weekly+3 daily), P2 MA confluence, P3 option-strike conversion, P4 analyst commentary, P5 structural extremes + LSZ + 4H S/D + intra-zone, P6 fib/round grid, P7 derivatives arena, P8 EURUSD-strike->DXY, P9 regime/ZFP/measured move. Dimensions: technical, options, analyst, structural, psychological, regime (+structural-extreme bonus up to +2).

properties.content: KEY ARCHITECTURE FACT: Pillars 3/4/7/8 need FX option expiries (10am NY cut, >=$1.5B critical / $850M-1.499B significant) and analyst commentary - NOT derivable from OHLC. A bar-replay Pine indicator can only compute the OHLC-derivable half dynamically (S/D origin candles, swings/LSZ, pivots, MAs, round numbers, touch-density rungs). Option/analyst dimensions need an input channel or are absent.

ZFP-conditioned transitions: BS->target ZFP<20% (hard wall) => RWL (NOT R/PBS); 20-40% => R; >60% => PBS; >80% => strong PBS. SS with bounding ZFP>45% => BS; both <30% => SS continues; WLS => BS (very high); R persisting >1 session => reclassify SS; WL with opposite momentum => RWL else SS.

MoM decision tree: sharp whiplash instantly => pierced, BS/WL opposite; minor reaction+retest, zone holds => long consolidation (SS 2-4 days); zone breaks but price returns => short consolidation SS->BS/WL; no pierce => slow consolidation then retest opposing liquidity then pierce to BoM liquidity. BoM zones always react.
Swing Scalps (NOT 'sideways squeeze'): range between ceiling/floor IP zones, both ZFP<30%; 2-5 sessions; London scalp session; both directions valid; Double-Whiplash subtype.
Breakout Surge: decisive break of a zone with ZFP>45%; 1-3 sessions toward next zone/structural extreme; NY swing session.
Piercing BS: pierces multiple intermediate zones (failing zone ZFP>70%).
Recovery: transitional stabilisation/retrace after BS or WL; <1 session else reclassify SS. RS = Recovery Surge (sharp).
Whiplash: spike-and-reject at an IP zone (rejection is the key). PWL = piercing variant.
Reverse Whiplash: WL opposite to preceding BS; most common follow-on after BS; at hard walls ZFP<20%. PRWL = strongest reversal.
Whiplash Storm: 3+ similar-pressure zones in 0.30-0.50 DXY band, violent oscillation 2-5 sessions; almost always resolves into BS.

Observed chain frequency: SS->BS->R->WL (default week), SS->BS, BS->R->RWL, BS->RWL->SS->BS, WL->RWL->SS->BS, R->RWL->SS->BS, BS->RWL->PBS, BS->R->PBS, SS->BS->SS->BS, WLS->BS->WLS, WLS->SS->PBS, PBS->R/SS->PRWL->SS.
Day-level bridge: E2 day-by-day decomposition -> E3 DAY/SESSION/SHAPE/CATEGORY/ANCHOR-HIT labels on every setup; +1 day speed shift; SS->London, BS/WL->NY; 'blind-executable' (BE1-BE12).
R3 LAW: E2 DESIGNATES, E3 OBEYS. Every anchor traces to an E1 zone id + E2 shape day. E3 never overrides E1/E2 or fabricates levels. Honest absence: no valid SL/TP/RRR => NO emission.

Entry: sniper edge nearest approaching price (SHORT=supply bottom, LONG=demand top); IP zones are NEVER entries (only ORDER_BLOCK or LQZ sources); internal LMV rung near-edge when zone contains one; never anchor LONG at supply. 4-stage freshness gate (index>2 skipped; any pierce = VIOLATED).

SL: ladder-steps (3p outside back edge OR 1-2p inside next-rung close edge); relevant zone by pressure state; per-pair buffers EU2/GU3/AU3/DXY5; D17 36p ceiling; rocket SL 1 full pip outside back edge. TP: ONE TP per trade at opposing pressure; strong zone = near edge (+1-2p spread), weak = far edge; Law-14 TP>=1.2xSL. RRR floor 3.0 (norm 4+), refine up to 3 attempts before hard reject (D36).

Rockets = trip-wire stop-limit orders set in London premarket: FLR (Earth-heavy, 30m Fib trigger, thick buffer 2 thick/2-3 thin), FR (Fire precision, 15m Fib, 2 buffer), LR (Water precision, thin buffer, 20-30% fail ok). Fib: entry .618-.786, rocket1 1.382-1.786 (cleanest, ~90%), trigger 2.382-2.786, target 3.382-3.786. Max 3/trade (2 recommended), one pair at a time, never reinforce thin zones. Master Trade Setup = E + FLR = Avatar State (all 4 elements).
Cascade: DXY LONG -> EU SHORT (inverse) -> GU SHORT (kept). Mirror zone CLASS not literal price (80/20 doctrine). >=24 setups/week acceptable, no caps (D38). 35% divergence = flag only.

BoM/MoM enforcement; 1-2-3 retest timing (no swing before 3rd retest, no scalp before 2nd); 30-min red-folder deferral; close ALL by NY close (Profit Taking Law); NY rockets need >=3p SL; Direction Validation 6-check (4H trend, BoM alignment, LSZ direction, zone failure cascade, macro shape, counter-trend); 4+ of 6 disagree => reverse.
